LightningComponentBundle.description: Marketing and Data - Configurable marketing engagement timeline (Email, SMS, Form, Page View) with live search and typed colored icons. Mock data mode - no Apex, no SOQL. Bilingual EN / FR.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls card title, search placeholder, event type labels and empty state text.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the language dictionary default.

property.name: eventTypes
property.label: Event types (pipe-separated)
property.default: Email ouvert|SMS envoye|Formulaire|Email clique|Page vue|Email rejete|Email envoye|SMS clique
property.description: FR: Email ouvert, Email envoye, Email clique, Email rejete, SMS envoye, SMS clique, Formulaire, Page vue. EN: Email Open, Email Sent, Email Click, Email Bounce, SMS Sent, SMS Click, Form Submit, Page View.

property.name: eventLists
property.label: Lists / campaigns (pipe-separated)
property.default: Campagne Ete 2026|SMS Relance Auto|Webinaire Produit Q2|Nurturing Web|Acquisition SEO|Offre Flash Juin|Campagne Rentree|Promo Weekend

property.name: eventAges
property.label: Relative ages (pipe-separated)
property.default: 2 j.|4 j.|1 sem.|1 sem. 3 j.|2 sem.|3 sem.|1 mois|1 mois 5 j.
